units.function: A 21-line FastAPI prototype exposes GET /health and POST /compile; compile_intent parses an untyped YAML string and returns a fixed four-step plan with requires_approval=true.
units.dependencyDirection: HTTP route directly parses and constructs output; there is no service, domain, port, persistence, event, plugin, runtime or adapter boundary. FastAPI and PyYAML are used; declared pydantic is unused.
units.keyDataModels: No request/response schema. Parsed YAML is assumed to be a mapping with goal; output is an ad hoc dictionary.
units.lifecycle: Stateless request/response only: no plan identity, version, diff, publication, approval state, audit, deletion, migration, retry, idempotency or recovery.
units.testAssessment: No tests. Malformed or non-mapping YAML, payload limits, concurrency, authentication and authorization are uncovered.
units.designRationale: Minimal demonstration endpoint, not the compiler architecture described in the README.
units.companyOsProblem: A design-time policy compiler may matter, but this implementation does not solve deterministic compilation, responsibility binding, versioning or governance.
units.companyOsFit: Negative evidence: a compile endpoint without typed IR, provenance and lifecycle is insufficient.
units.responsibilityConflict: requires_approval is a constant boolean, not bound to action digest, accountable human, authority, evidence or publication.
units.licenseAssessment: No license grant exists at the pin; code copying is prohibited.

units.function: Declares the repository experimental and compile-only and excludes runtime execution, tool calling and autonomous planning.
units.dependencyDirection: Contributor policy only; no executable dependency.
units.lifecycle: Issue-first contribution workflow; no release, security or compatibility lifecycle.
units.testAssessment: No test commands or quality gates are specified.
units.designRationale: Constrain a learning prototype to design-time exploration.
units.companyOsProblem: Scope discipline between design-time compilation and runtime execution is relevant.
units.companyOsFit: Useful separation principle, but not an enforceable boundary.
units.responsibilityConflict: No accountable maintainer, security path or change authority is defined.
units.licenseAssessment: Documentation is not licensed for reuse at this pin.

units.function: One intent fixture and one manually authored compiled-plan JSON illustrate constraints, tools, approval and a five-step topology.
units.dependencyDirection: Disconnected examples; the backend neither loads them nor produces the shown topology.
units.keyDataModels: Intent has goal, domain, tools, constraints and actions; output has topology, risk, approval and steps, but no schema defines them.
units.lifecycle: No source hash, compiler version, diff, validation, publication state or runtime receipt.
units.testAssessment: No golden test. Example output differs from hardcoded backend output, so it is illustrative rather than generated evidence.
units.designRationale: Show a possible portable design-time artifact shape.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS may need versioned organization/policy IR and deterministic fixtures.
units.companyOsFit: Intent/artifact separation is relevant, but untyped examples are too weak to adopt.
units.responsibilityConflict: human_approval identifies no human, authority, exact action, digest, evidence or result contract.
units.licenseAssessment: No license grant; examples cannot be copied.

units.function: Proposes a design-time compiler with intent routing, curated topology library, specialization, tool contracts, policy, simulation, validation, version/diff and runtime-neutral artifacts.
units.dependencyDirection: The proposed compiler would precede runtimes, but none of its named engine modules or runtime adapters exist in tracked code.
units.keyDataModels: Narrative concepts only: Intent, Topology, Tool Contract, Policy, Baseline and Diff Plan; no formal schema or state machine.
units.lifecycle: Narrative intent-to-publish flow; roadmap leaves rich schema, deterministic selection, diffing, exports and approvals unchecked. Seven commits, no tags or releases.
units.testAssessment: No test evidence. Repository has no tests, CI, schema, migrations, frontend, auth, audit, events, plugin SDK or deployment definition.
units.designRationale: Make decision logic explicit and reviewable before execution.
units.companyOsProblem: Policy and organization intent may need to compile into versioned runtime-neutral artifacts instead of mutating execution implicitly.
units.companyOsFit: Reference the design-time/runtime separation only; do not treat listed features as implemented.
units.responsibilityConflict: Human permission philosophy aligns directionally but has no identity, authority, responsibility contract or approval publication.
units.licenseAssessment: No license grant. Ideas may be discussed, but wording and code must not be copied.
